name: ecs-high-memory
title: An ECS service has sustained high memory utilisation
description: An ECS service has had average memory utilisation at or above 85% for 45 minutes.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected ECS service.
Check the service task count, scaling activity and running task health.
Review recent deployments and investigate memory growth or unusually expensive requests.
The service may be in a degraded state due to high memory usage and could be unavailable to handle requests.
Scale the service if necessary to handle the load and reduce memory utilisation with breakglass if this is the case, or take other remedial actions to restore service health.
